snippet.title: Vettel gives his Azerbaijan GP verdict! 🇦🇿 Will Baku spark Russell title fightback? 👀
snippet.description:
Has George Russell rediscovered his mojo after a lights-to-flag victory in Baku?
Rosanna Tennant is joined by Marc Priestley and Harry Benjamin to reflect on the race and Russell’s impressive performance.

Four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel is also on the podcast to give his take on the day, share what he’s been up to since leaving Formula 1 and reflect on Kimi Antonelli’s remarkable season so far.
